title: Psalm 14
opening_line: That there is not a God, the fool

source.note: Received text from the official Free Church digital edition and plain-text archive.

text.diplomatic: That there is not a God, the fool
text.normalized: That there is not a God, the fool
text.reading: That there is not a God, the fool

text.diplomatic: doth in his heart conclude:
text.normalized: Doth in his heart conclude:
text.reading: doth in his heart conclude:

text.diplomatic: They are corrupt, their works are vile;
text.normalized: They are corrupt, their works are vile;
text.reading: They are corrupt, their works are vile;

text.diplomatic: not one of them doth good.
text.normalized: Not one of them doth good.
text.reading: not one of them doth good.

text.diplomatic: Upon men’s sons the LORD from heav’n
text.normalized: Upon men’s sons the LORD from heav’n
text.reading: Upon men’s sons the LORD from heav’n

text.diplomatic: did cast his eyes abroad,
text.normalized: Did cast his eyes abroad,
text.reading: did cast his eyes abroad,

text.diplomatic: To see if any understood,
text.normalized: To see if any understood,
text.reading: To see if any understood,

text.diplomatic: and did seek after God.
text.normalized: And did seek after God.
text.reading: and did seek after God.

text.diplomatic: They altogether filthy are,
text.normalized: They altogether filthy are,
text.reading: They altogether filthy are,

text.diplomatic: they all aside are gone;
text.normalized: They all aside are gone;
text.reading: they all aside are gone;

text.diplomatic: And there is none that doeth good,
text.normalized: And there is none that doeth good,
text.reading: And there is none that doeth good,

text.diplomatic: yea, sure there is not one.
text.normalized: Yea, sure there is not one.
text.reading: yea, sure there is not one.

text.diplomatic: These workers of iniquity
text.normalized: These workers of iniquity
text.reading: These workers of iniquity

text.diplomatic: do they not know at all,
text.normalized: Do they not know at all,
text.reading: do they not know at all,

text.diplomatic: That they my people eat as bread,
text.normalized: That they my people eat as bread,
text.reading: That they my people eat as bread,

text.diplomatic: and on GOD do not call?
text.normalized: And on GOD do not call?
text.reading: and on GOD do not call?

text.diplomatic: There fear’d they much; for God is with
text.normalized: There fear’d they much; for God is with
text.reading: There fear’d they much; for God is with

text.diplomatic: the whole race of the just.
text.normalized: The whole race of the just.
text.reading: the whole race of the just.

text.diplomatic: You shame the counsel of the poor,
text.normalized: You shame the counsel of the poor,
text.reading: You shame the counsel of the poor,

text.diplomatic: because GOD is his trust.
text.normalized: Because GOD is his trust.
text.reading: because GOD is his trust.

text.diplomatic: Let Isr’el’s help from Zion come:
text.normalized: Let Isr’el’s help from Zion come:
text.reading: Let Isr’el’s help from Zion come:

text.diplomatic: when back the LORD shall bring
text.normalized: When back the LORD shall bring
text.reading: when back the LORD shall bring

text.diplomatic: His captives, Jacob shall rejoice,
text.normalized: His captives, Jacob shall rejoice,
text.reading: His captives, Jacob shall rejoice,

text.diplomatic: and Israèl shall sing.
text.normalized: And Israèl shall sing.
text.reading: and Israèl shall sing.
